description: Show a candidate's children on an open page as it is now, in at most 40 lines like open_page's, opening the largest first. A candidate with more than 40 children is paged: pass pageNo for the next pages. Says how many candidates the page gained since you last looked (+N new), with new ids. If the page can't be read again, it is closed: open it again with open_page.
name: expand
